packs.name: General Test Plan Pack
packs.purpose: Create a structured, cross-project test plan defining scope, strategy, scenarios, resources, entry/exit criteria, schedule, risks, and deliverables.

packs.name: General Exploration Pack
packs.purpose: Pre-orientation exploration — scope discovery, option enumeration, situation assessment for ambiguous or open-ended tasks before committing to a specific task mode.
